All other calendar services in this diff (Google, Hubspot, Lark, Office365, Webex, Zoho-bigin, Zohocrm, Zoom) wrap their token refresh calls with refreshOAuthTokens() to support the credential sync endpoint feature. Salesforce is the only one that doesn't use this wrapper, meaning it won't use CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true. This is an inconsistency/bug in the implementation of the credential sharing feature.
